name: Stephen I crowned
summary: Stephen I of Hungary receives a royal crown from Pope Sylvester II (or his legate) on Christmas Day 1000 (or January 1, 1001), accepting Latin Christianity for his kingdom. He organizes Hungary into a diocese system with archbishops at Esztergom, defeats pagan Magyar chieftains who resist conversion, and establishes a legal system based on Carolingian models. The 'Crown of Saint Stephen' becomes the symbol of Hungarian statehood for the next millennium.

_quarry.structural_significance: Integrates Hungary into Western Christendom; establishes the institutional church as a pillar of Hungarian governance; the Crown of Saint Stephen becomes the symbol of Hungarian statehood
